description: This file contains a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'EmpEmergencyContactDao' responsible for handling database operations related to employee emergency contacts in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching emergency contact records associated with employees.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing employee emergency contact records in the database.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Saves an employee emergency contact. Determines next sequence number if necessary and validates it before persisting.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Retrieves a specific emergency contact for a given employee based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingSeqNosForEmpNumber
methods.description: Gets existing sequence numbers for an employee, filtering against provided sequence numbers.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Deletes emergency contacts for an employee based on a list of sequence numbers.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Retrieves all emergency contacts for a specific employee, ordered by name.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Searches emergency contacts based on filter parameters using pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsPaginator
methods.description: Prepares a paginator object for searching emergency contacts with filters and sorting.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of emergency contacts matching the search filter.
